name: laneconductor
description: LaneConductor: the plan-first workflow for tracks kept as files in git, as a Markdown-only base plugin, two optional add-ons (parallel work and a board) and five skill packs.

plugins.name: laneconductor
plugins.description: LaneConductor: the skill, slash commands and a read-only plan reviewer for tracks kept as files in git. Markdown only; works on its own.

plugins.name: laneconductor-parallel
plugins.description: Add-on: parallel work in git worktrees with conflict-checked track writes (a local connector) and a track-runner subagent.

plugins.name: laneconductor-board
plugins.description: Add-on: the board script and page, a private snapshot of every track by lane; and opt-in hooks that keep it current. No commands: it is refreshed with /laneconductor:board refresh.

plugins.name: laneconductor-nodejs-frontend
plugins.description: Skills for Node.js front ends: an installable Vite PWA with Workbox, and browser speech synthesis that is actually audible.

plugins.name: laneconductor-firebase
plugins.description: Skills for Firebase and one shared GCP project: a Hosting site and Functions codebase per product, cache busting after deploys, and Google-only sign-in.

plugins.name: laneconductor-node-postgres
plugins.description: Skills for Node.js apps on Postgres: local Postgres with Neon in production and the connection string in Secret Manager, Prisma inside Cloud Functions, an isolated test database, and a Makefile for local runs.

plugins.name: laneconductor-gemini
plugins.description: Skills for calling Gemini from Node.js: every LLM call through TokenTalos, Gemini on Vertex AI with Application Default Credentials, and image generation with retry and a GCS upload.

plugins.name: laneconductor-skill-from-code
plugins.description: Skills for authoring: turn a pattern or a verified incident, shown by working code, into a new skill, and package your skills as Claude plugins and submit them to the plugin directory.

plugins.name: laneconductor-analytics-monitoring
plugins.description: Skills for knowing how a product does: Google Analytics 4 behind a consent choice with Search Console ownership and a tested sitemap.xml and robots.txt; production monitoring on Google Cloud as one idempotent script; structured logs and a slow-query log that alerts can count.
